cards.title_en: Byblos (Jbeil) Maritime Harbor & Cedar Trade
cards.explanation: Byblos is an ancient seaside harbor where wooden boats sailed across the blue water carrying fragrant cedar wood and golden olive oil.

cards.title_en: Myth of Isis, Osiris, and the Sacred Tree of Byblos
cards.explanation: An old storybook legend says a carved wooden chest floated across the sea to Byblos and a tall fragrant tree grew around it to keep it safe.

cards.title_en: Afqa Spring, Nahr Ibrahim, and the Seasonal Myth of Adonis
cards.explanation: When spring rain falls on the mountains, red clay washes into the river and turns the water bright rust-red while spring flowers bloom along the banks.

cards.title_en: Sarcophagus of King Ahiram & the 22-Letter Phoenician Abjad
cards.explanation: Match five ancient picture-letters carved in stone: Aleph looks like an ox horn, Beth is a house, and Mem looks like ocean waves!

cards.title_en: Writing, Recipes, and Oral Memory as a Portable Archive in the Lebanese Diaspora
cards.explanation: Help Teta Nahla put her favorite man’oushe recipe card and harbor postcard back into the family memory chest!

cards.title_en: Bayt al-Hikma (House of Wisdom) & Abbasid Translation Tradition
cards.explanation: In old Baghdad by the river, scholars gathered colourful scrolls and books to share stories and star maps with friends from many lands.

cards.title_en: Scholars of Baghdad: Al-Khwarizmi, Al-Kindi, Hunayn ibn Ishaq, Thabit ibn Qurra & Banu Musa
cards.explanation: Meet the clever inventors of Baghdad who built playful water fountains, mechanical lamps, and number games!

cards.title_en: Contested Chronicles: Weight-in-Gold Payments & 1258 River-of-Ink Accounts
cards.explanation: People in Baghdad loved books so much that storytellers said a good book was as precious as shining gold!

cards.title_en: Al-Mutanabbi Street, Shabandar Café & the International Book Solidarity Archive
cards.explanation: Walk down Baghdad’s book street where friendly shopkeepers stack colourful storybooks on tables beside the river!

cards.title_en: Cardamom Date Kleicha, Shanasheel Courtyards & Plural Diaspora Memory
cards.explanation: Roll sweet date paste and fragrant green cardamom into pinwheel kleicha cookies with Bibi Amal in the sunny courtyard!

cards.title_en: Egyptian Fanous Lanterns & Competing Fatimid/Coptic Origin Narratives
cards.explanation: Glowing fanous lanterns in bright red, blue, and gold light up Cairo’s streets to welcome family and friends!

cards.title_en: Cairo Lantern Metalwork, Stained Glass & Khayamiya Tentmaker Appliqué
cards.explanation: Match bright ruby-red, emerald-green, and golden glass shapes to build a glowing lantern and colourful tent cloth!

cards.title_en: Neighborhood Soundscapes: The Musaharati Drummer & Festive Cairo Chants
cards.explanation: Follow the gentle tap-tap rhythm of the neighborhood drum as lanterns light up along the friendly Cairo street!

cards.title_en: Teta Samira’s Koshari & Inclusive Courtyard Hospitality
cards.explanation: Sort white rice, brown lentils, red tomato sauce, and crunchy golden onions into baskets for Teta Samira’s big koshari pot!

cards.title_en: Egyptian Diaspora Celebrations & Ontario Egyptian Heritage Month Candidate Fact
cards.explanation: Children living far from Egypt fold colourful paper lanterns with safe little battery lights to share Cairo’s warm glow with new friends!

cards.title_en: The Traboules of Vieux Lyon and La Croix-Rousse
cards.explanation: Follow the painted pastry signs through cosy stone arches and spiral stairs that connect one sunny Lyon courtyard to the next!

cards.title_en: The Canuts of La Croix-Rousse & Jacquard Punch-Card Silk Weaving
cards.explanation: Match colourful threads and card holes to weave a shimmering flower pattern on a tall wooden loom!

cards.title_en: Cour des Voraces, Labor Mutualism & Historical Memory in Lyon
cards.explanation: Look up at the grand stone staircase in the courtyard where neighbors helped one another carry baskets up six tall floors!

cards.title_en: The Mères Lyonnaises & Eugénie Brazier: Women-Led Culinary Craft
cards.explanation: In Lyon’s warm kitchens, caring grandmothers and women chefs taught young helpers how to bake golden pastries and share meals!

cards.title_en: Galette des Rois, Kitchen Brigade Teamwork & Transnational Pastry Exchange
cards.explanation: Help Mamie Claire layer flaky pastry, tuck in the little porcelain fève charm, and place the golden paper crown on the table!

cards.title_en: Bibimbap (Goldongban) & Regional Variants: Jeonju, Jinju, Tongyeong & Andong
cards.explanation: Arrange warm rice, crunchy bean sprouts, yellow mung-bean jelly, and cooked mushrooms into a colourful Jeonju bowl!

cards.title_en: Competing Origin Narratives of Bibimbap: Ritual, Court, Agriculture & Lunar New Year
cards.explanation: Families, farmers in the fields, and festival guests all loved mixing colourful vegetables with warm rice in one bowl!

cards.title_en: Obangsaek (오방색): Five-Color Cultural Symbolism & Harmony of the Bowl
cards.explanation: Sort five bright colours into the bowl: green spinach, red carrots, yellow jelly, white rice, and dark mushrooms!

cards.title_en: Jeonju Hanok Village, Giwa Roofs, Nambu Market & Pungnammun Gate
cards.explanation: Place curved dark roof tiles, sturdy pine wood pillars, and warm paper doors to care for Halmeoni’s cosy hanok courtyard!

cards.title_en: Shared Bowls, Chuseok Songpyeon & Korean Diaspora Cultural Continuity
cards.explanation: Fold half-moon songpyeon rice cakes over fragrant green pine needles and share a happy harvest feast in the garden!
